summary: When is the best time for newborn photos?

messages.text: When is the best time for newborn photos?

The ideal time for newborn photos is between 5 and 20 days old. During those first couple of weeks, babies tend to sleep more deeply and naturally curl into those gentle, womb-like poses. 

Our newborn sessions are kept very calm and unhurried, usually lasting around two hours so there is plenty of time for feeding, cuddles, and settling breaks.
